name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Embossed Transparent Acrylic Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 2 layers of transparent acrylic for a clean, dimensional, and elegant decorative sign.
                +) Layer 1: Transparent Acrylic 3mm with 1-sided printing.
                +) Layer 2: Transparent Acrylic 2mm with 1-sided printing.
    - The 2-layer construction creates a refined layered effect that enhances depth and gives the sign a premium finished appearance.
    - The top transparent acrylic layer features glossy raised print, adding texture and a decorative stained-glass-inspired effect.
    - Transparent acrylic offers a sleek, modern look while allowing the printed artwork and raised detailing to stand out beautifully.
    - Custom-shape construction allows the sign to be produced in decorative silhouettes that complement personalized artwork and event themes.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available size: 16 x 24 in ~ 40.64 x 60.96 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Both acrylic layers feature high-quality 1-sided UV printing for crisp text, vivid colors, and detailed personalized artwork.
    - The top transparent acrylic layer features glossy raised printing that adds visible and tactile texture to selected outlines and design elements.
    📌 Please Note: Raised glossy effects are not automatically added. They will only be produced if the raised line details are included in the customer’s artwork file.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized decorative sign for baby showers, weddings, bridal showers, engagements, birthdays, receptions, and other special celebrations.
    - Suitable for displaying welcome messages, names, event dates, invitations, themed wording, and decorative artwork.
    - Ideal for use as a welcome sign, entrance display, party décor, reception decoration, backdrop accent, or keepsake sign.
    - The 2-layer transparent acrylic construction creates a bright, elegant presentation while the raised glossy print enhances floral, ornamental, and stained-glass-inspired designs.
    - Durable layered construction makes the sign suitable for both event display and long-lasting keepsake use.
    - Especially suitable for custom designs featuring floral frames, event themes, and personalized celebration details.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for couples, parents-to-be, family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for baby showers, weddings, bridal showers, engagements, anniversaries, and milestone celebrations.
    - Great for creating custom event signage featuring names, meaningful dates, welcome wording, and decorative artwork.
    - Ideal as a memorable keepsake that can continue to be displayed after the event.
    - A beautiful personalized décor piece that combines two transparent acrylic layers with glossy raised print detailing for a distinctive premium finish.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Embossed Transparent Acrylic Sign

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.3-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
